Season 22 brings some of the biggest crab hauls you've ever seen! Watch as the captains find rare red king crab in dangerous storms, Sig and Sophia hit the jackpot with hybrid crab, and more!

About Deadliest Catch:
Crab fishermen risk their lives as they battle Arctic weather, brutal waves and a ticking clock for big money in this modern-day gold rush on the Bering Sea.
